oracle.currentOracle: v48 在 collection_id+book_id 上提供业务唯一约束；Repository 重复调用、直接 DAO 重复写入以及重启后均只保留一条关系。
oracle.desiredSemantics: v48 在 collection_id+book_id 上提供业务唯一约束；Repository 重复调用、直接 DAO 重复写入以及重启后均只保留一条关系。

semanticProjections.name: serial-repository-relation-count
semanticProjections.description: 串行执行两次 Repository 后的有效关系数
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM collection_book WHERE book_id = :serialBook AND collection_id = :targetCollection AND is_deleted = 0

semanticProjections.name: serial-repository-updated-date
semanticProjections.description: Repository 新关系沿用 BaseEntity 的 updated_date 零默认值；无关系时投影为 -1
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(updated_date), -1) AS updated_date FROM collection_book WHERE book_id = :serialBook AND collection_id = :targetCollection AND is_deleted = 0

semanticProjections.name: direct-dao-duplicate-relation-count
semanticProjections.description: 无唯一约束时 DAO 可写入的同书同书单有效关系数
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM collection_book WHERE book_id = :duplicateProbeBook AND collection_id = :targetCollection AND is_deleted = 0

semanticProjections.name: collection-relation-unique-schema-count
semanticProjections.description: collection_book 表或索引中包含 UNIQUE 声明的对象数量
semanticProjections.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unique_guard_count FROM sqlite_schema WHERE tbl_name = 'collection_book' AND UPPER(COALESCE(sql, '')) LIKE '%UNIQUE%'
